To avoid ambiguity, here’s an explicit conversion for the confirmed slot I’ll send:

Confirmed (new invite attached) — Option A
- Nov 15, 2026 — 09:00 SGT (UTC+8) / 10:00 JST (UTC+9) / 12:00 AEDT (UTC+11)

Why this should resolve the mismatch:
- Tokyo (JST) does not observe DST; Singapore (SGT) stays at UTC+8 year-round; Sydney is currently on AEDT (UTC+11) since Oct, so there is a +2 hour offset from Tokyo.
- If your Google Calendar is set to a non-APAC timezone (or a user-level locale/tz mismatch), the event may show the calendar date as Nov 15 in one view but Nov 14 in another. The attached .ics is stamped with the timezone info explicitly.

I’ve recreated the invite with timezone-aware timestamps and attached apac-demo-invite.ics. Also including an agenda link and the HubSpot deal in case you want to add attendees: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-8942.
